label: Collections manifest
type: the cluster-node-tracked version counter (manifest_uid) recording the current state of a bucket's scopes and collections, incremented whenever a collections-related change is made. Monitored via cbstats, not couchbase-cli.
evidence: The manifest_uid value is associated with the current state of collections on the node; and will be incremented whenever a collections-related change is made.
note: Identical explanatory sentence duplicated verbatim across all four cbstats collections/scopes (base and -details) pages - the round's authorship-provenance watch flagged this as copy-paste, but the underlying fact (one manifest_uid per node/bucket, cluster-wide) is real and consistently stated, not contradicted.
relates_to_competency_question: How does an administrator tell whether a bucket's scope/collection topology has changed since it was last inspected?
